identity.description: Pipedrive is a sales CRM and pipeline management software with a developer platform, API, marketplace and an official MCP server.
identity.identity_notes: Sources are from pipedrive.com and developers.pipedrive.com.

auth.oauth_flows: Pipedrive MCP connects via secure OAuth login.
auth.scopes_notes: AI assistant can only access data the Pipedrive user has permission to view and edit.

access.production_restrictions: Marketplace listing implied for reaching customers; details not in sources. Sandbox testing account is listed as a feature on the top pricing plan, but developer sandbox signup is available on the developers site.

api.limitations: API reference not in sources; protocol and breadth not directly established.

claims.quote: Connect your AI assistant to Pipedrive in minutes via a secure OAuth login.
Sign up for a Sandbox Account today to begin experimenting and developing in a risk free environment
Their developer API, well-documented API reference page and easy use of webhooks allow developers to easily build solutions in the Pipedrive Developer Platform.
Easily build integrations with our API and developer platform to reach over 100,000 companies through the Pipedrive Marketplace
Pipedrive MCP is built and maintained by Pipedrive and follows our security standards.
14-day free trial, no credit card required

open_questions: Developer API auth methods (API token, OAuth scopes) not in sources.
API breadth, rate limits and REST protocol not directly documented in sources.
Whether sandbox requires a paid plan: pricing page lists sandbox on top plan, while the developers page offers sandbox signup.

assessment.approach: Wrap/benchmark vendor's official MCP server; add managed auth
rationale: Self-serve test credentials (free self serve) and a documented REST interface.
